name: image-reveal
blurb: Image appears and follows cursor on list item hover.
description: List of text items that reveal associated images on hover. Image tracks cursor position with spring physics animation and fades in/out.
use_when: Product pages, case studies, or portfolio galleries where image previews enhance list browsing.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces — hover and pointer tracking required.
a11y: List items are semantic text; images revealed on hover but not keyboard-accessible.
